description: Evaluate a volumetric function at one or more 3D sample points and return a float result per point. Useful for verifying SDF values numerically without rendering. Supports functions with a single vec3 input and float output. Returns a structured error for unsupported graph types.

function_id.description: ModelResourceID of the function to evaluate

samples.description: List of sample points. Each entry is an object mapping argument names to their values. For a function with a single vec3 argument named 'pos', each entry should be {"pos": [x, y, z]}. For scalar arguments, use {"name": value}.

results.description: One float value per sample point, in the same order as the input samples array.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Present only when success is false.

examples.description: Evaluate a unit sphere SDF at three points
